title: Design System Registry Entry
description: Schema for a single design-system pack in the agent's design-systems/ registry. Each pack is a self-contained, named, opinionated set of tokens + component snippets that an LLM agent loads before generating UI for a user who picked this pack.

name.description: Lowercase kebab-case identifier. Used as the folder name and the AskUserQuestion option value.

version.description: SemVer. Bumped when tokens or component snippets change in a way that affects generated output.

description.description: One-line description shown in AskUserQuestion. Should include the palette hint (e.g. 'Indigo, neutral, editorial').

palette.description: Concrete palette hint shown to the user during pack selection. Each value is a hex color.

tokens.description: Relative path to the W3C-aligned tokens.css file inside this pack folder. Three layers: primitive (raw values), semantic (role-bound aliases), component (component-scoped).

dependencies.description: npm packages the project must have installed for this pack to work. Agent checks these before generating; if missing, falls back to shadcn-default and warns.

importMap.description: Map of component name → module path. Used by the agent to know where to import Button, Input, etc. for THIS pack.

fontStack.description: Font stacks for body, headings, and code. Agent injects these into globals.css / Tailwind config.

sampleComponents.description: Inline code snippets for the top 8 components, so the agent can copy-paste instead of inventing. Each entry is { name, code }.

code.description: Full TSX source — references var(--...) tokens, never hardcoded values.

bestFor.description: Tags describing what this pack is best for. Used by the agent to recommend a default if the user is unsure.
